eras.note: 150 seats are elected from 109 unique district boundaries — 68 single-member and 41 two-member districts. Veto override is 2/3 of members present, not full elected membership — the seat figure here assumes full attendance. The app's composition data currently shows 142 total seats; the correct chamber size is 150.
